summary: Tested the Server-provider manual password gate (backend + frontend). Backend /api/verify-server-access returns 401 for wrong password and {success:true,configured:true} for 'interview2026'. Frontend UI flow verified end-to-end via real browser (Playwright) at the preview URL: (1) Gemini is default/active with gemini-key-input visible; (2) clicking provider-server reveals server-password-form while Gemini stays active and localStorage.serverAccessGranted stays null; (3) wrong password shows server-password-error 'Mot de passe incorrect — vous restez en mode Gemini.', Gemini remains active, grant stays null; (4) correct password 'interview2026' hides the form, hides gemini-key-input, shows 'Mode Serveur : aucune clé requise' info box, and sets localStorage.serverAccessGranted='true'; (5) after unlock, clicking Gemini then Serveur again does NOT re-prompt. All 5 acceptance checks pass.
critical_code_review_comments: SettingsPanel.jsx is OK; hmac.compare_digest usage on backend is correct for the password comparison.
Consider rate-limiting /api/verify-server-access to prevent brute-force (not blocking, informational).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Manual Server-provider password gate works correctly end-to-end. Gemini->Server automatic fallback path in lib/api.js was intentionally NOT tested. Preview app auto-creates a session on load; no auth needed to open AI Settings.
